questions: Are you having involuntary movements, shaking, or jerking episodes?
Do these episodes involve loss of awareness or inability to respond?
Do you completely lose consciousness during any episode?
Do the episodes begin suddenly and end suddenly?
Do you remember what happens during the episodes?
Can you stop or suppress the movements when you try?
Do the movements lessen when you are distracted?
Are the movements worse when someone is watching you?
Do the episodes occur only in certain situations or when you feel stressed?
Have you ever bitten your tongue or lost bladder control during an episode?
Have you ever injured yourself during one of these episodes?
Do you experience weakness or inability to move one side of your body?
Do you have numbness or tingling on one side?
Do you have trouble speaking, seeing, walking, or keeping your balance?
Do you have severe or new headaches?
Have you had a recent head injury, infection, or fever?
Have you ever had epilepsy, seizures, fainting, or similar episodes before?
Are you taking any medications or substances that could affect your movements?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medication?
Have you previously been diagnosed with anxiety, depression, trauma-related illness, or another psychiatric condition?
